caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair has a rounded, slightly oval-shaped backrest comprised of six evenly spaced vertical spindles connecting the curved top rail to the wooden seat. The seat is contoured and appears to be made from a solid piece of wood, showing visible grain and subtle curves. Four legs support the chair, each slightly angled outward for stability, and are connected by stretchers forming an "H" shape on the left and right and a single stretcher at the back. The wood is illustrated in shades of brown, with darker lines indicating grain patterns and subtle texture variations. The composition is minimal, with no other objects present, and the artist's name, "Roger E. Deats Del. 550," is printed in small, brown text at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Windsor Comb-Back Chair
